image_description: A brambling (Fringilla montifringilla) perched on a wooden bird feeder, eating bread. The bird has a brownish-grey head with streaks, orange-rufous breast, black wings with white wing bars, and a short conical bill. The feeder is made of wood with a flat roof covered in pine needles and moss, and has metal springs hanging from it. There is text 'l'Eau genio' in red in the bottom right corner.
